description: Source code for a Spring MVC Controller class 'RelatedItemsController' which manages related product items in an e-commerce admin panel. It includes endpoints for displaying related items, paginating, adding, and removing related product relationships, with security annotations and service interactions.

classes.name: RelatedItemsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for handling related product items in the admin interface, providing listing, pagination, addition, and removal functionality with security roles.

methods.name: displayRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the related items page for a specific product, validating ownership and preparing data for the view.

methods.name: pageRelatedItems
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch paginated related product data in JSON format, returning related product details.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a related product relationship between two products.

methods.name: removeItem
methods.description: Handles POST request to remove a related product relationship.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets the menu context for the admin page, highlighting active menu items.
